public_seam: CampaignReportSourceService and apex-research.campaign-report-source.v1 through WorkspaceClient immutable publication and paginated lineage queries
identity_impact: The source identity canonically hashes every meaning-bearing campaign source field, explicit availability, current-record selection, budget and archive interpretation, and complete public lineage while excluding source_id, wall-clock publication metadata, local paths, storage metadata and presentation metadata.
evidence_level: Apex-owned deterministic interpretation of already published campaign, candidate, failure, budget, Evidence v2, qualification currency and archive owner facts for Strategy Reporting presentation only; it creates no Runtime metrics, formal truth or production authority.
fail_closed_behavior: Missing, conflicting, cyclic, duplicated, drifted, identity-mismatched, non-canonical, over-bounded or unsafe public records fail closed without private storage, Runtime or external-process fallback; Reporting may not traverse or reinterpret the campaign graph.
